verses.t: “Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, soceyyāni. Katamāni tīṇi? Kāyasoceyyaṁ, vacīsoceyyaṁ, manosoceyyaṁ— imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi soceyyānī”ti. Etamatthaṁ bhagavā avoca. Tatthetaṁ iti vuccati:
“Kāyasuciṁ vacīsuciṁ, cetosucimanāsavaṁ; Suciṁ soceyyasampannaṁ, āhu sabbappahāyinan”ti.
Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti. Sattamaṁ.
